query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Migrate active Todoist projects, sections, tasks, subtasks, labels, due dates, priorities, durations, and assignment metadata into a private ClickUp Space, then verify the migration without modifying Todoist source data.

query_ground_truth.intent: Recreate the Todoist project hierarchy, tasks, subtasks, and all associated metadata within the new ClickUp Space.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step 1]: Create the space using CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE (start with minimal payload; capture space identifier; if custom statuses are needed, retry without them if validation fails).
[Required] [Step 2]: Create folders in the space using CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDER (capture a folder identifier per folder; batch/parallelize when many).
[Required] [Step 3]: Create lists in folders using CLICKUP_CREATE_LIST (requires folder identifier; capture a list identifier per list).
[Required] [Step 4]: Create tasks in each list using CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK (requires list identifier; parallelize after identifiers are known; persist full results so task identifiers are recoverable).

[Optional (if you must map dropdown/options for later updates)] [Next Step]: Discover custom-field and option identifiers using CLICKUP_GET_ACCESSIBLE_CUSTOM_FIELDS (record option identifiers for target fields).
[Optional (if task fields need adjustment after create)] [Next Step]: Modify tasks after creation using CLICKUP_UPDATE_TASK (use captured task identifiers).

[Required] [Fallback (if lists must live outside folders or folder creation is skipped)] [Fallback]: Create a list directly under the space using CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDERLESS_LIST (capture list identifier, then proceed with CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE] Including custom statuses/features at create time can fail validation; retry with a minimal payload and add advanced configuration later if supported.
[CLICKUP_GET_ACCESSIBLE_CUSTOM_FIELDS] Field listings can be large and appear truncated; extract identifiers/options from the full JSON response.
[CLICKUP_UPDATE_TASK] Dropdown-style updates typically require option identifiers (not labels) sourced from CLICKUP_GET_ACCESSIBLE_CUSTOM_FIELDS.
[CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK] Bulk create responses can be large/truncated in previews; persist the full payload to reliably capture created task identifiers.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parse a saved bulk task-create result JSON to extract task identifiers and titles
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json,sys
obj=json.load(sys.stdin)
rows=[{"id":r["response"]["data"]["id"],"name":r["response"]["data"]["name"]} for r in obj["results"]]
print("\n".join(f"{x['id']}\t{x['name']}" for x in rows))
```

CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE.description: Creates a new ClickUp Space within a specified Workspace, allowing feature configuration which defaults to Workspace settings if unspecified.

team_id.description: Numeric ID of the Workspace (Team) for the new Space.

multiple_assignees.description: Enable/disable multiple assignees for tasks in this Space.

features__tags__enabled.description: Enable/disable Tags. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__checklists__enabled.description: Enable/disable Checklists. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__enabled.description: Enable/disable Due Dates. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__portfolios__enabled.description: Enable/disable Portfolios. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__custom__fields__enabled.description: Enable/disable Custom Fields. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__start__date.description: Enable/disable Start Date for Due Dates (if Due Dates enabled). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__time__tracking__enabled.description: Enable/disable Time Tracking. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__time__estimates__enabled.description: Enable/disable Time Estimates. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__dependency__warning__enabled.description: Enable/disable Dependency Warning (shows conflict warnings). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__remap__dependencies__enabled.description: Enable/disable Remap Dependencies (auto-adjusts task dates). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__remap__due__dates.description: Enable/disable subtask due date remapping (if Due Dates enabled). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__remap__closed__due.description: Enable/disable closed subtask due date remapping (if Due Dates & subtask remapping enabled). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDER.description: Creates a new ClickUp Folder within the specified Space, which must exist and be accessible.

name.description: The name of the Folder to be created.

space_id.description: Numerical ID of the Space in which to create the Folder.

CLICKUP_CREATE_LIST.description: Creates a new list in ClickUp within an existing folder. This action requires a folder_id - lists cannot be created directly in a Space using this action. If you need to create a list directly in a Space (without placing it in a folder), use the 'CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDERLESS_LIST' action with space_id instead.

name.description: The name to be assigned to the new list.

status.description: Optional. Defines the list's color in the ClickUp UI (e.g., 'red', 'blue'). **Important:** This 'status' refers to the visual color of the list itself, not the workflow statuses (like 'To Do', 'In Progress') of tasks within the list.

examples: Detailed plan for all Q3 marketing activities.
Tasks related to the initial phase of Project Alpha.
content.description: Optional descriptive content or notes for the list.

assignee.description: Optional. Numerical user ID of the assignee.

due_date.description: Optional due date for the list, represented as a POSIX timestamp in milliseconds. For example, `1695110307000` for September 19, 2023, 07:58:27 AM GMT.

priority.description: Optional priority level for the list. Integer values map to: 1 (Urgent), 2 (High), 3 (Normal), 4 (Low).

folder_id.description: The unique numerical identifier of the folder where the new list will be created. Note: This action creates a list within an existing folder. A folder_id is required and space_id cannot be used. If you want to create a list directly in a Space (without a folder), use the 'CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDERLESS_LIST' action instead.

due_date_time.description: Optional. A boolean flag indicating whether the `due_date` includes a specific time. If `True`, the time component of `due_date` is respected. If `False` or not provided, the list is considered due on the entire day specified by `due_date`.

CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK.description: Creates a new ClickUp task in a specific list, optionally as a subtask if a `parent` task ID (which cannot be a subtask itself and must be in the same list) is provided.

name.description: The name of the new task.

parent.description: ID of an existing task to be the parent (creating a subtask). Parent must not be a subtask and must be in the same list.

status.description: Status name for the task. IMPORTANT: Each ClickUp list has its own unique status configuration. Common names like 'todo', 'done', or 'in progress' often do NOT exist - you must use the exact status names (case-sensitive) configured in the target list. To get valid statuses, call GET /list/{list_id} and check the 'statuses' array in the response for available status names. If omitted, uses the list's default status (recommended when valid statuses are unknown).

list_id.description: The ID of the list where the task will be created.

team_id.description: Team ID, required only if `custom_task_ids` is `true`.

due_date.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

links_to.description: ID of an existing task to link as a dependency.

assignees.description: User IDs to assign to the task.

notify_all.description: `True` to send notifications to all task watchers, including the creator.

start_date.description: Start date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to apply. See ClickUp API for structure.

due_date_time.description: `True` if `due_date` includes a specific time, `false` if it's an all-day task.

time_estimate.description: Estimated time to complete, in milliseconds.

custom_item_id.description: Custom task type ID. Omit or use `null` for standard tasks (recommended). Custom task types including Milestones (ID `1`) are subject to workspace plan quotas. Only specify a custom_item_id if you have confirmed the workspace has available quota for that task type. Use GET /team/{team_id}/custom_item to check available custom task types and their quotas.

custom_task_ids.description: Enables referencing tasks by custom task ID; requires `team_id` if `true`.

start_date_time.description: `True` if `start_date` includes a specific time, `false` if it's an all-day task.

check_required_custom_fields.description: `True` to enforce filling all required Custom Fields upon creation.

CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERS.description: Retrieves Folders within a specified ClickUp Space, ensuring `space_id` is valid, with an option to filter by archived status.

archived.description: Filter Folders by archived status. `True` for archived, `False` for unarchived. Omit to return both.

space_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the Space from which to retrieve Folders.
